theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_rellich_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (u j)) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, u j x ^ 2 ≤ M) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ (u j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ M) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Euclid n → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1)) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, (u (φ j) x - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
